page_note: 该页为OECD成人技能调查报告第116页，上半部为图3.6（27个国家/经济体三类受教育程度人口占比在两轮调查间的百分点差异范围图），下半部为正文文字。

heading.title: Change in educational attainment of the adult population between cycles
heading.subtitle: Difference in the shares of adults with below upper secondary, upper secondary and tertiary education (Cycle 2 minus Cycle 1); 25-65 year-olds

figures.source_line: Source: OECD (2018[4]; 2015[5]; 2012[6]), Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC) databases, http://www.oecd.org/skills/piaac/publicdataandanalysis/ (accessed on 23 September 2024); Table B.3.1 (Trend) in Annex B.

components.evidence: axis runs 20 to -20 with a heavy rule at 0; markers sit above and below it
thick horizontal rule drawn across the panel at the 0 tick
a vertical segment per country joins its dash, diamond and triangle markers
legend shows 'Below upper secondary' as a short horizontal dash placed at the country position
dash, diamond and triangle markers plus vertical connector segments in one panel
'Below upper secondary  Upper secondary  Tertiary' row sits between subtitle and plot
country names 'Korea', 'Ireland', 'Flemish Region (BE)' set vertically under the axis
'Round, Cycle 1:' grey banner under country names split into segments labelled 1, 2, 3
beige vertical bands in the plot before 'Lithuania' and before 'Hungary'
'Percentage point difference' printed above the top tick 20, left of the plot
'Percentage point difference' is the only place the scale word appears; ticks read 20, 10, 0
category 'Poland*' with note '*Caution is required in interpreting results...'
'Note: Does not include adults who in Cycle 2...' and 'Source: OECD (2018[4]...' below the plot
axis labels 'Flemish Region (BE)' and 'England (UK)' printed in blue, others black
vertical rules separate each country slot from 20 down through the label band

new_components.name: marker_shape_encodes_series
new_components.evidence: series distinguished by shape: dash, diamond, triangle, all read on the same value axis
new_components.why_it_matters: 读值时必须先按标记形状判定系列，颜色几乎不携带信息，错认形状即错认系列。

new_components.name: axis_group_band_with_row_label
new_components.evidence: grey banner under axis labelled 'Round, Cycle 1:' with cells '1', '2', '3'
new_components.why_it_matters: 每个国家还带一个'调查轮次'属性，表格行需要额外一列才能唯一定位该点。

new_components.name: three_point_range_line
new_components.evidence: one vertical segment per country spans three markers, not the usual two-point dumbbell
new_components.why_it_matters: 连接线本身不代表某个量，读者需分别读三个标记，不能用线段长度推断数值。

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签，纵轴只有20/10/0/-10/-20五个刻度，10个百分点约占40像素，每像素≈0.25个百分点；要把'2'读到5%（±0.1个百分点）内在物理上不可能，'6''8'也需辨认到±0.3–0.4个百分点，而三种标记（短横、菱形、三角）在27个国家的窄槽中彼此重叠、部分被连接线遮挡，连判定某标记属于哪个系列都有风险。相比之下定位标签只需'国家名+系列名'两个键，表格容易承载。

suggestions.new_ablation_row: 形状编码系列 vs 颜色编码系列，比较系列归属判定错误率

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 axis_group_band_with_row_label（轴下带行标题的分组色带）
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段增加 group_band 层级键，并在markdown导出中作为额外一列输出
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有/无轴下分组带时，定位单个标记所需键数从2升到3的检索命中率

suggestions.what_to_add: three_point_range_line（每类目三个标记由一条竖线相连）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图族权重向量中新增 range/dumbbell 家族，并允许每槽标记数>2
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 两点哑铃图 vs 三点区间图的逐标记读数精度

suggestions.what_to_add: readable 改为逐标记可达精度（本页刻度间距10个百分点、无数值标签）
suggestions.where_to_change: 评分条件行中的 readable 布尔门改为按标记像素/单位分辨率给出容差
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 以像素分辨率为容差 vs 固定5%容差时的通过率差异

suggestions.where_to_change: 图元数据的heading字段与轴上方单位文本位置
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位置于轴上方 vs 置于副标题时，数值单位还原正确率
